link.title: Recipes in Bitbybit
link.description: Solids described as data rather than built: a list of steps such as polygons, extrusions, cuts and unions, and the results to build from them. A recipe holds no variables or expressions, so any kernel can build it and it travels well as JSON, between threads, files and CAD Cloud. These pages cover how a recipe is written and how bitbybit.recipes checks one, reads one from JSON, follows a node to the step it places and draws the triangle meshes it holds.
